header.name: Cell Biology and Biochemistry
header.description:
The aim of this basic core course is to provide students a decent background in cell biology and biochenmistry. The major focus is to 
a) cover most important concepts in cell biology like structure and functions of cell, proteins, and signal transduction mechanisms b) cover biological thermodynamics, enzyme kinetics and metabolism and finally c) solve qualitative and quantitative problems.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to understand fundamental cell biology processes, forces that mediate interactions between biomolecules, can describe biochemical reactions and time scales in biology.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to understand the biological thermodynamics, enzyme kinetics and metabolism. Students are able to solve qualitative and quantitative problems related to the same

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to identify the stereochemical molecules, can write empirical equations for weak forces and understand the application of molecular dynamics simulations.

lecture_topics: Overview of cell biology and Biochemistry
Quick overview of structure and function of carbon and nitrogenous molecules, stereo-isomers, bond angles, bond length in peptide bonds
Ramachandran plots, logic of biochemistry, simple reaction mechanisms like Substitution, elimination reactions etc with arrow diagrams
Time-scales in cell biology, procedural, relative and manipulated time with examples from cell cycles, development and evolution
Intra and inter molecular forces, Weak forces like vander-waals, electrostatic forces etc. empirical equations that describe these forces, introduction to simulations
Enzyme kinetics and Allostery, Glucose metabolism

resources.title: Physical biology of the cell, Jane Kondev, Julie Theriot, and Rob Phillips .
Lehninger Principles of Biochemistry, Nelson and Cox
Essential cell biology 4th Ed. by Bruce Alberts, Dennis Bray, Karen Hopkin Alexander Johnson, Julian Lewis, Martin Raff, Keith Roberts, Peter Walter
